Subject: Request: evidence for recent supplier ownership transition (NimbusOps)

Vanessa,

We received a notification earlier this week that one of Redwood's subprocessor vendors, NimbusOps, completed an ownership transfer to Orion PE on 2028-06-28. As part of our procurement and third-party risk update for GlobalBank, we need the following items to complete the acceptance checklist and confirm no material change to critical controls:

1) Official change-of-ownership record or share transfer deed from NimbusOps
2) List of people/accounts at NimbusOps with admin/network access to Redwood infrastructure (VPN, SSH jump hosts, SSO provisioning)
3) Any revised subcontractor / subprocessor agreements post-transfer
4) Timelines for escrow/continuity measures and whether any code or keys were moved into escrow

Please treat this as time-sensitive — our risk committee will review this week. If you prefer, we can set up a quick 30-min call with our security procurement and risk teams tomorrow.

Thanks,
Liam Carter
Senior Procurement Manager
GlobalBank

Liam / Team — attaching the primary artifacts here and summarizing control impacts.

Summary (top-line):
- Ownership transfer: NimbusOps was acquired by Orion Private Equity (Orion PE). We have received the executed share purchase agreement and the certificate of transfer. There is no planned change to NimbusOps' operational management team in the next 90 days.
- Admin access: The current admin roster for systems that touch Redwood production is small and role-based. No Orion PE principals currently have direct admin access to runtime or key management systems.
- Subcontracts: NimbusOps provided an addendum (redacted) reflecting the transfer; no change to SLA or data handling clauses that affect Redwood's commitments.
- Escrow: NimbusOps placed their core deployment automation (Terraform, CI/CD manifests) into a third-party escrow with CodeLock Escrow on 2028-06-29. We have the escrow receipt and the DocuSign envelope id below.

What I'm attaching to this email (and also placing in the secured drive folder):
- nimbus-ownership-deed.pdf (executed transfer certificate, redactions applied)
- access-audit-20280701.csv (roles + redacted account identifiers; admin accounts hashed where appropriate)
- redwood-subprocessor-roster-20280703.xlsx (current roster with vendor roles)

DocuSign / Escrow references:
- DocuSign envelope: DS-escrow-GB-2028 (link provided in Drive)
- Escrow provider: CodeLock Escrow — confirmation receipt included in folder

Controls note: we performed an ad-hoc verification of NimbusOps' privileged access controls prior to and after the transfer. No elevated access migrations were observed. Our runtime key material is held in customer-specific KMS stores, and we maintain independent key custody for host-level credentials used by subprocessors.

If GlobalBank requires unredacted account identifiers for a formal audit, we can coordinate an NDA + controlled evidence transfer process (we will need to redact PII for non-essential fields).

Let us know if you want a short technical walkthrough (20–30m) of the access controls and escrow arrangement; Rishi and Monica can present.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Product Security
Redwood Inference
